bio: Love of cooking, attentiveness to guests: the spirit of gratitude is etched in the restaurant’s name, which means ‘gathering of the gods’. The chef recreates traditional Japanese dishes and serves them on vessels by modern ceramic artists, expressing the Japan of today. His process for drawing dashi for soup resembles that of a coffee drip; to preserve the natural flavour, the only seasoning is salt. Meticulous food preparation and attentive service say ‘thank you’ better than any words....
